The '''Orsis Academy''' was a school that trained [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], trackers, [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], and was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orsis]]. Notable students at the Orsis Academy throughout its history included the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]], his father [[Agnuk]], and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

==History==
[[File:Maultraining.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Maul became one of the best fighters in the academy before destroying it.]]
A disguised [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] enrolled [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] at the [[Orsis]] Academy when he was eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old in order to hone his combat skills. The Academy's headmaster was a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] named [[Trezza]], who generously accepted Maul without a physical examination. The Academy typically trained students for 4-8 years, with graduates sometimes returning to hone their skills. The school was forbidden to train [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] but Trezza did not object to ignoring this rule on occasions.

[[File:SW-Adventures-Cradossk.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Cradossk whom graduated from the academy.]]
Maul quickly became the school's top student in the 7 years he was there; however, he also destroyed the facility, killing all students and faculty, following an order from [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]]. Maul got inside the academy and entered dorms, killing every cadet inside. He soon found his "friend" [[Kilindi Matako]], headmaster Trezza, and his combat instructor [[Meltch Krakko]] in Trezza's office. Maul battled Krakko briefly and the cadet was killed. Trezza pleaded with Maul to calm himself, but Maul did the exact opposite. Trezza threw a knife at Maul but Maul used the Force and the [[Knife/Legends|knife]] deflected back into Trezza's chest. Trezza fell dead onto his desk. He soon killed Kilindi. Trezza's [[Death/Legends|death]] marked the end of the Orsis Academy.
